BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses çemel for a likeness. Across its 5 occurrences the word stays true to that sense, whether it stands in 2 Chronicles or in Deuteronomy. That steadiness is what makes it worth knowing.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that çemel proves nothing in Scripture is filler. A likeness turns up again and again because God wants it noticed.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
